name: Nonstop Kino
notes: Members-only preview-screening events for the nonstop cinema subscription; /events/ lists all ~62 events (past+future) on one page with data-date="YYYYMMDD" per <article>, detail page gives time (colon format only) and location; a few events are in Graz (filtered out, city text contains 'Graz'); price is always unknown (subscription access, not per-ticket, so 'Nur für Mitglieder' etc. goes in category, price_min stays null); one event ('Lord of The Rings Event') lists 3 separate dates in one string and is split into 3 occurrences; site only publishes ~3.5 months ahead currently (last event Nov 2026 as of Aug 2026 scrape) so horizon_days=90 already captures nearly everything; image is the detail page's og:image (100% fill, same page already fetched for date/location/description, no extra requests); no runtime field exists anywhere on the site (club/preview events, not standard listings) so extra.duration_min is never emitted, not guessed
